projects.title: Arcade Lounge
projects.summary: A static multiplayer games site where players connect directly, so there is no game server.
projects.description: Connect Four, Guess the Country and Escape Rooms, all playable against a friend through a shared link. Peer to peer over WebRTC, hosted as plain static files, with a night-mail airmail stamp design across the landing page and hub.

projects.title: Real Estate 3D Viewer
projects.summary: Turns ordinary listing photos into a walkable Gaussian splat scene, from COLMAP to a browser viewer.
projects.description: A free-tools pipeline: extract frames, reconstruct camera positions with COLMAP, train a splat on a free Kaggle GPU with nerfstudio, then view the result in a three.js viewer with a property picker. Verified end to end on a real 59 photo capture.

projects.title: Booking System
projects.summary: A standalone availability and reservation API for restaurants.
projects.description: A small self-contained service that answers availability questions and takes reservations, designed so any front end or agent can sit on top of it.
